errors.description: The ancillary example is incorrect: after 15,18 the next term is 20, while 22 is coprime to 15 and cannot occur. Replacing 22 by 20 repairs the example without affecting the proof.

parsed.notes: The main proof is logically complete: it correctly reduces membership to small-prime support and derives global periodicity. The sole issue is an easily repaired factual typo in a nonessential example.
